fields.body_en: KAU-FPO is a digital platform by Kerala Agricultural University that connects Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs) with buyers, government schemes, expert advisors, and AI-based crop recommendations. It supports FPO registration, product listing, buyer verification, and DPR generation.
fields.keywords: about what platform overview introduction

fields.body_en: To register an FPO on the KAU-FPO Platform, visit /register and choose the FPO option. Complete the eligibility check with your member count and business type, verify your phone number and email via OTP, then fill out the four-step wizard covering basic info, legal registration, business details, and bank details.
fields.keywords: signup sign up new account create

fields.topic: How to register as a buyer
fields.body_en: To buy from FPOs, visit /register?mode=buyer. Verify your phone number and email via OTP, set a password, and submit. Your buyer account will be reviewed by KAU admin within 1 to 2 business days. Once verified, you can log in and browse all FPO products.
fields.keywords: buyer signup buy products purchase external

fields.body_en: Anyone can browse FPO products, commodity prices, and demand opportunities at /market-hub without logging in. To submit a purchase inquiry, click any product and use the Inquire button — no account required.
fields.keywords: market hub browse products prices public

fields.body_en: For help with the KAU-FPO Platform, email kau-fpo@kau.in or use the feedback form at /contact-us. KAU responds within 2 business days.
fields.keywords: contact help support email

fields.body_en: To register, your FPO must have at least 10 members and a legal business structure (Companies Act, Producer Companies Act, Kerala Cooperative Societies Act, or similar). You will need your PAN, GST (if applicable), CIN (for companies), bank details, and a Kerala district address.
fields.keywords: eligibility requirements minimum members legal

fields.body_en: A 6-digit OTP will be sent to your office email. Enter it within 10 minutes to verify. You can request a new OTP up to 3 times per 10-minute window. Both email and phone must be verified before you can submit your application.
fields.keywords: email otp verify code

fields.body_en: A 6-digit SMS OTP is sent to your office phone number. Enter it within 10 minutes. Rate limited to 3 attempts per 10-minute window. Both email and phone verification are required to submit.
fields.keywords: phone sms otp mobile verify

fields.body_en: Three documents are mandatory: FPO Registration Certificate, Bank Details proof (cancelled cheque or bank letter), and PAN Card. Optional: GST certificate, Signatory ID, Member List, Annual Report. PDF, JPG, or PNG. Max size 5 MB (10 MB for member list and annual report).
fields.keywords: documents upload certificate pan gst required

fields.body_en: Complete all four wizard steps, verify both email and phone, upload the three required documents, and click Submit. After submission the application is auto-approved instantly — you will see the status change to APPROVED and receive an email and SMS confirmation.
fields.keywords: submit apply application status finalize

fields.body_en: View your application status at /fpo/status. Statuses: DRAFT (in progress), SUBMITTED (auto-approved instantly), APPROVED (active), INFO_REQUIRED (KAU needs more info), REJECTED (denied), or SUSPENDED. The timeline shows every status change.
fields.keywords: status application progress timeline

fields.body_en: Your FPO dashboard shows your tier badge, application status, team summary, document verification status, and quick links to profile, recommendations, products, and settings.
fields.keywords: dashboard home overview

fields.body_en: Go to /fpo/recommendations and click Request Recommendation. The AI analyses your zone, soil, and season to suggest suitable crops with reasoning. Generation takes about a minute. Only available after FPO is approved and if the FPO is located inside Kerala.
fields.keywords: recommendation ai crop suggest predict

fields.body_en: Go to /fpo/dpr and click New Project. Fill in the wizard sections (project basics, location, product details, finance, etc.), then click Generate to produce a PDF Detailed Project Report. AI narrative sections are auto-generated but editable.
fields.keywords: dpr detailed project report pdf generate

fields.body_en: From /fpo/team click Invite. Enter their name, email, and phone. A temporary password is emailed to them; they will be prompted to change it on first login. There is no limit on the number of team members you can invite.
fields.keywords: team invite add member user

fields.body_en: FPOs can also buy from other FPOs. Visit /fpo/buyer-directory and click Register as Buyer. Your registration will be reviewed by KAU admin. Once approved, browse products the same way external buyers do.
fields.keywords: fpo buyer buy other fpos

fields.body_en: KAU admin typically verifies buyer accounts within 1 to 2 business days. You will receive an email confirmation once verified. Until then you can log out and browse the public market hub at /market-hub.
fields.keywords: pending review verify wait status buyer

fields.body_en: Verified buyers can browse all FPO products at /buyer/products. Filter by commodity, price range, and quantity. Click a product to see FPO details and quantities available.
fields.keywords: buyer browse products search commodity price

fields.body_en: On your buyer dashboard, complete your profile by selecting your district and the commodities you are interested in. This helps FPOs match you with relevant products.
fields.keywords: buyer profile complete commodities district

fields.body_en: Open /admin/applications, filter by SUBMITTED status, and open a row. Verify all documents are marked verified in the Documents tab, then click Approve. Approval triggers an email + SMS to the FPO.
fields.keywords: admin approve fpo application verify

fields.body_en: Open /admin/buyers, filter by Pending status, review the buyer's details, and click Verify. This activates their login and lets them browse FPO products. You can also Reject with a reason.
fields.keywords: admin verify approve buyer external

fields.body_en: Go to /admin/crop-package-of-practices and click Add. Enter the crop name (must match ML predicted names), season, varieties, spacing, and other PoP sections. Save as inactive first, review, then activate.
fields.keywords: crop pop knowledge base add package practices

fields.body_en: Crop zone profiles at /admin/crop-zone-profiles control which crops the AI recommends per KAU physiographic zone. Only active profiles affect recommendations. Editing exports the full active set to the ML service.
fields.keywords: zone profile crop eligibility ml recommendation

fields.body_en: On the login page click Forgot Password. Enter your email — you will receive a reset link valid for 15 minutes. FPO users receive an SMS OTP instead. Follow the link or enter the OTP to set a new password.
fields.keywords: forgot password reset link email otp

fields.body_en: From your account settings, click Change Password. Enter your current password and the new one twice. New password must be at least 8 characters with an uppercase, lowercase, digit, and special character.
fields.keywords: change password update security

fields.body_en: Click the language switcher (EN/ML) at the top-right of any page. Your preference is saved to your account when logged in.
fields.keywords: language malayalam english switch translate

fields.body_en: Super admins and sub-admins must enable 2FA. From your account settings go to Security, scan the QR code with Google Authenticator, and enter the code to activate. Save your backup codes securely.
fields.keywords: 2fa two factor authenticator qr backup

fields.body_en: Click the bell icon at the top-right to open your inbox. You will see in-app notifications for application status changes, approvals, recommendations, and system announcements.
fields.keywords: notification bell inbox alerts

fields.body_en: Click your avatar at the top-right and choose Logout. This ends your session and clears authentication cookies. You will be redirected to the login page.
fields.keywords: logout log out signout exit

fields.body_en: Most list pages have a search bar at the top. Type at least 2 characters to filter. Some pages also let you filter by status, category, or district using dropdowns.

fields.topic: FPO Registration — Eligibility Check — User Manual
fields.body_en: Module: KAU-FPO Platform (Public/Registration Portal) Page: FPO Registration — Step 1: Eligibility Check
fields.keywords: manual FPO Register fpo registration — eligibility check — user manual

fields.body_en: The Eligibility Check page is the first step of the FPO (Farmer Producer Organization) registration process on the KAU-FPO Platform. Its purpose is to confirm that an FPO meets the minimum requirements before allowing it to proceed with full registration. This prevents ineligible organizations from completing an application, saving time for both the applicant and the reviewing administrators.
fields.keywords: manual FPO Register 1. purpose

fields.body_en: Navigate to the KAU-FPO Platform's public registration URL (typically reached via a "Register" or "Apply Now" link on the platform's home/login page). The Eligibility Check page loads as Step 1 of the 3-step registration process. Users who already have an account can skip registration by clicking Sign in (top right) instead.
fields.keywords: manual FPO Register 2. how to access this page

fields.body_en: A 3-step horizontal tracker shows the registration journey: This indicator helps the user understand how far along they are in the registration process.
fields.keywords: manual FPO Register 3.2 step progress indicator

fields.body_en: Section Title: "Eligibility Check." Subtitle: "Let's confirm your FPO meets the minimum requirements before registering." — explains the purpose of this step.
fields.keywords: manual FPO Register 3.3 eligibility check form

fields.body_en: A boxed section labeled "Requirements" lists the mandatory eligibility criteria, each with a checkbox: ☐ Registered under an applicable Act (Companies / Cooperative / Producer Companies / Societies) ☐ Holds a valid registration certificate
fields.keywords: manual FPO Register requirements checklist

fields.body_en: Check Eligibility button (bottom right, green) — submits the entered district, member count, and confirmed requirements to validate eligibility and proceed to the next step if criteria are met.
fields.keywords: manual FPO Register 3.4 action button

fields.topic: 4. Typical Workflow for Completing This Step
fields.body_en: Select District — Click the District dropdown and search for/select the applicable district. Enter Total Farmer Members — Type in the total number of farmer members (must be 10 or more). Review Requirements — Read through the three eligibility requirements listed.
fields.keywords: manual FPO Register 4. typical workflow for completing this step

fields.body_en: Ensure the Total Farmer Members count is accurate and meets the stated minimum of 10 — entering a lower number may block progress to the next step. Use the Accept all link only when genuinely confident that all three requirements are met, since these are compliance-related declarations regarding legal registration, certification, and banking status.
fields.keywords: manual FPO Register 5. tips for efficient use

fields.body_en: Complete Step 1: Eligibility Check and click Check Eligibility to proceed. The platform automatically advances to Step 2: Verify Phone. After successful OTP verification, the platform automatically advances to Step 3: Account.
fields.keywords: manual FPO Register 2. how to access these pages

fields.body_en: Section Title: "Verify Phone Number." Subtitle: "We'll send a one-time password to confirm your mobile number." — explains the purpose of this step.
fields.keywords: manual FPO Register 3.3 verify phone form

fields.body_en: Confirm the Phone Number shown is correct. Wait for the OTP to arrive via SMS (indicated by the "OTP sent to ••••••7212" banner). If the OTP is not received, click Resend to trigger a new one.
fields.keywords: manual FPO Register 3.5 workflow

fields.body_en: Double-check the phone number before requesting the OTP — an incorrect number will prevent the SMS from arriving. OTPs are typically time-limited; if verification fails after a delay, use Resend to get a fresh code.
fields.keywords: manual FPO Register 3.6 tips

fields.body_en: Section Title: "Create Your Account." Subtitle: "This account will be used to manage your FPO profile." — explains the purpose of this step.
fields.keywords: manual FPO Register 4.2 create account form

fields.body_en: ← Back — returns to Step 2 (Verify Phone). Create Account & Continue (green) — submits the account details to create the user account and proceeds with FPO registration.
fields.keywords: manual FPO Register 4.3 action buttons

fields.body_en: Enter First Name and Last Name. Enter a valid Email Address. Confirm the Phone Number field shows "Verified in previous step" (no action needed here).
fields.keywords: manual FPO Register 4.4 workflow

fields.body_en: Use a strong password (mixing letters, numbers, and symbols) even though the minimum requirement is only 8 characters, since this account will manage sensitive FPO data. Double-check the Email Address for accuracy, as it will likely be used for login and important notifications going forward. Ensure Password and Confirm Password match exactly — a mismatch will likely block account creation.
fields.keywords: manual FPO Register 4.5 tips

fields.body_en: Every registered FPO is graded on a 4-tier scale — Tier A, B, C, or D — based on a 28-question assessment covering governance, financial health, member engagement, market linkages and operations. The tier appears as a badge on the FPO dashboard and is used by KAU + partner agencies when allocating schemes, subsidies and capacity-building programmes.
fields.keywords: tier grading rating classification A B C D score assessment

fields.body_en: The tier is assigned from the total assessment score out of 100: Tier A requires 80 or higher, Tier B is 65 to 79, Tier C is 50 to 64, and Tier D is below 50. Thresholds are set in code and are the same for every financial year.
fields.keywords: tier threshold score cutoff 80 65 50 A B C D

fields.topic: How the Tier Score is Calculated
fields.body_en: The FPO answers 28 questions grouped into scoring criteria and domains (Governance, Finance, Operations, Market Linkage, etc.). Each criterion has a max marks cap and a scoring rule; the total is the sum of capped criterion scores across all active criteria. Answers can be text, numeric, or based on uploaded supporting documents.
fields.keywords: scoring criteria domain question weight max marks calculation

fields.body_en: The FPO must complete one tier assessment per financial year (April to March). Answers can be saved as a draft and revisited from /fpo/tier-assessment. Submit when all required questions are answered — the score and tier are computed and locked immediately on submit.
fields.keywords: submit financial year draft complete assessment when

fields.body_en: Every completed assessment writes an append-only row in the tier history for that financial year — previous tiers are never overwritten. An FPO can be promoted (e.g. Tier C → Tier B) or demoted between financial years. The current tier is the most recent history row.
fields.keywords: history promotion demotion append financial year record change over time promoted demoted next year evolve improve tier movement

fields.body_en: The FPO sees its own tier on the FPO dashboard and tier assessment page. KAU admins, sub-admins with the assigned FPO, government officials in the jurisdiction, and the assigned CBBO can also see it. Other FPOs never see one another's tier.
fields.keywords: visibility privacy dashboard scoping who sees tier

fields.body_en: A submitted assessment is locked. Only a super admin can reopen it — usually to fix a data-entry error before the KAU review window closes. Reopening does NOT delete the previous score; the FPO can edit answers and resubmit, which creates a new score for the same financial year.
fields.keywords: reopen unlock edit resubmit lock super admin correction

fields.body_en: Some questions ask for supporting documents (audit report, AGM minutes, bank statement, etc.). Upload them from the tier assessment page — accepted formats are PDF, JPG, PNG, and the size cap is 5 MB per file. Missing documents may reduce your score for the associated criterion.
